intended_object: An auxiliary set: for this library's finite code (bottom, removal, top) of a maximal flag, the set of bars whose removal time is before stage j. Inferred from the docstring and from the module documentation of MaximalFlagBridge.
explanation: This is an internal bookkeeping helper for a library-specific encoding (`Code p`, a triple of permutations) of maximal flags, used in a proof about Fox–Neuwirth order complexes. It is used only to define `retainedBars`, `stageBlock` and `stageKey`, which build the code-to-simplex bridge. It has no standard counterpart in the literature. Its body matches the docstring: it filters the bars r whose removal index `z.removal.symm r` is less than j.
